Index reduction, constraint drift and explicit stabilization for a pendulum Derive an explicit ODE from an index-three position constraint and compare drift and stabilization for consistent and inconsistent starts. Assumptions, units and boundaries m=L=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity; off-manifold controls explicitly add radial velocity. Editorial clarification No projection, normalization or SHAKE/RATTLE; no general index-three-solver or symplecticity claim. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions. Adopted numerical method Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages.
